title: 初三短对话：影片与水杯
source_notice: 初三公开普通期末转载完整题面/印本脚本/参考键已核，原音轨明确缺；地域学年学期只在标题，正文只见九年级英语，原校认证未建立，不当gold。本稿完整原创配套不补平原录音缺口。
timing_notice: 每段两遍；原卷未印精确停顿，本机听前后每题5秒及重播提示属审阅编排
instruction: 听五段短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍。原卷未印精确停顿，本机每题听前后各5秒，只作审阅编排。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: How do you practise French pronunciation, Ella? Do you repeat lines from films?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Sometimes. But recording my own voice and comparing it with the lesson audio helps me most.

options: Comparing her recording with lesson audio.
questions.rationale: A：未看无声影片；B：未说抄词；C：明确helps me most对应比较录音

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: This blue cup was on your desk. Is it yours?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No, mine is white. The blue one belongs to our art teacher. I borrowed it to hold some paintbrushes.

questions.rationale: A：男方杯子是白色；B：明确属于美术老师；C：女方只是询问者

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I thought the coach left at half past eight.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That was last month's timetable. From this week it leaves twenty minutes earlier.

questions.stem: When does the coach leave now?
questions.rationale: A：8:30减20分为8:10；B：旧时刻；C：把提前误算推迟

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: My bicycle chain keeps coming off. Shall I buy a new bicycle?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You probably only need a small repair. Take it to the shop by the post office first.

options: Have the bicycle checked at a shop.
questions.rationale: A：建议先维修而非立即买；B：未要求处处步行；C：明确先去店里处理

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Have you chosen a title for your report on our town's old bridge?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes, but I still need a photograph from before it was repaired. The library may have one in its local history collection.

questions.stem: What does the girl still need?
options: An old photograph of the bridge.
A bus ticket to the town.
questions.rationale: A：标题已选好；B：明确需修桥前照片；C：无车票需求
